title: Battery passport
description: The successor to battery@2 under manifest version 2, published as a draft that a deployment selects by explicit version. Every field carries a requirement status separate from the profile's own obligation: enacted where an instrument in force names it, anticipated where the value waits on a delegated or implementing act or a later application date, needs-review where the primary text could not be confirmed, not-to-be-displayed where the Commission's guidance says the value is not to be filled or displayed as of 18 February 2027, and none for an application addition. The Commission's guidance document on data points by category (version 2.0, 15 August 2026) is the interpretation source for the per-category applicability: a data point it makes conditional for industrial batteries is unresolved rather than failed or passed, and a record declares an inapplicable field under inapplicableFields. Item-level dynamic companions exist for the rated capacity, the ohmic resistance, the temperature and the state of charge. Every byte of battery@2 and of its generated files is unchanged; the migration outcome of every field is in succession.
regulatoryLine: Mapped to Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Annex XIII and Annex VI, read with the Commission's guidance on battery passport data points by category of 15 August 2026, ahead of the 18 February 2027 battery passport mandate; a mapping, not a conformance claim.

statements.text: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 is in force; its battery passport obligations apply from 18 February 2027 to the battery categories it covers.

The Commission's guidance document on battery passport data points by category (version 2.0, 15 August 2026, CC BY 4.0) is the interpretation source for the per-category applicability and the not-to-be-displayed statuses this profile records; by its own words it does not extend the rights and obligations of the legislation and is not the Commission's official position.
This profile's field-level mapping to Annex XIII, its category applicability and its clause citations are under review against the primary text and the licensed specification.

Stationary battery energy storage is carried as its own category and follows the industrial column of the guidance by this profile's reading of Article 3; the guidance does not list it separately, and the reading is unconfirmed.
